summary: Iteration 2: tested Phase 8 sandbox finance (ledger, settlements, hold release, bank accounts, withdrawals, payout retry/failure, auto-withdraw, v1 balances/settlements), Phase 11.1 homepage label removal, Phase 12 email adapter / admin login alert, 2FA rotation on a SECOND TEST_ admin, plus regressions. Backend: 42/42 pytest pass (41 in full suite + 1 rotation test). Frontend: homepage slider (4 images rotating, no 'Ilustrasi · QR DEMO', hero-photo-note present), feature card labels, /pay DEMO overlay, merchant Balance/Settlements/Withdrawals pages (add bank, request withdrawal, over-limit toast), admin Ledger (LULUS), Settlements confirm via prompt+TOTP, Withdrawals approve/reject via prompt+TOTP, /2fa?rotate=1 UI rotation all work. No critical bugs found. hold_hours restored to 6; all test data deleted.

minor.issue: Idempotency prior-lookup happens BEFORE _merchant_lock. Two concurrent requests with the SAME Idempotency-Key: second waits on lock, then insert_one hits unique index (merchant_id, idempotency_key) -> unhandled DuplicateKeyError -> 500 (code review; sequential same-key works). Re-check prior inside the lock or catch DuplicateKeyError and return existing.

No TOTP replay protection: the same 6-digit code can be reused for multiple sensitive actions within its window (observed: one code used for settlement confirm + withdrawal approve + reject). Consider storing last-used time-step per user.

Status transition and journal insert are two separate writes (no transactions on standalone Mongo). A crash between them leaves e.g. CONFIRMED settlement with no credit, or COMPLETED withdrawal without withdrawal_complete journal. Also PROCESSING withdrawals are never reclaimed if the worker dies mid-payout. Consider journal-first + reconciliation sweep, or a stale-PROCESSING recovery.

EMAIL_PROVIDER uses a default value os.environ.get('EMAIL_PROVIDER','emergent') - guideline says fail fast without defaults. Emergent email returned 429 rate_limited under test load; retries (3 attempts) worked and status logged FAILED in email_logs as expected.

issues: Verified bank status rendered as raw 'VERIFIED' text while rest of UI uses localized badges (merchant side shows 'Aktif').
Backend message 'Nominal penarikan harus Rp10000 - Rp50000000' not formatted as rupiah (Rp10.000 - Rp50.000.000).

action_items: Move withdrawal idempotency lookup inside the merchant lock (or catch DuplicateKeyError) to avoid 500 on concurrent same-key requests
Optional hardening: TOTP replay protection for step-up; recovery for stuck PROCESSING withdrawals / half-applied transitions
Minor UI: localize bank status in admin, format rupiah in withdrawal limit error
critical_code_review_comments: ledger.request_withdrawal: prior idempotency check outside lock (see backend minor issue)

Non-atomic status+journal pairs in ledger.py; invariants() would not detect a CONFIRMED settlement lacking a journal - consider adding that check (settlements CONFIRMED/RELEASED without settlement_confirmed journal)
Password hashing uses argon2 ($argon2...) not bcrypt - acceptable/stronger, noted for playbook check
Per-account lockout now works (test_login_wrong_then_lockout passes). CORS rejects foreign origin preflight (400, no ACAO).
